questions.q_en:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

17, 38, 84, ?, 376, 772

What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?

AH, CK, EN, GQ, ?
questions.solution_en:
The pattern here is:

A + 2 = C + 2 = E + 2 = G + 2 = I

H + 3 = K + 3 = N + 3 = Q + 3 = T

So, 'IT' will come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order.

All birds are crows.

Some crows are parrots.

No crow is a pigeon.

Conclusions:

I. No parrot is a pigeon.

II. Some birds are parrots.
options_en: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
questions.solution_en:
All birds are crows.

Some crows are parrots.

No crow is a pigeon.

I. No parrot is a pigeon is not TRUE as there is no restriction on relation between parrot and pigeon.

II. Some birds are parrots is not TRUE. Its possibility can be TRUE.

Hence, neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

Only daughter's father's paternal grandfather will be Amil's grandfather.

Only daughter's father's paternal grandfather's granddaughter will be Amil's sister.

Hence, the girl is the sister of Amil.

questions.q_en: What will be the angle between two needles of the clock (hour and minute) at 9 hours 36 minutes?
questions.solution_en:
Time = 9 : 36

Here, Hours = 9 & Minutes = 36

Angle between two needles of the clock = [(60 X hours) - (11 X minutes)] / 2

= [60 X 9 - 11 X 36] / 2

= [540 - 396] / 2

= 144 / 2

= 72º
